frontMatter.title: Halfway Through Summer Club! 🏸
frontMatter.summary: Join us for Week 5 at Claremont Stadium tonight from 8pm to 11pm for a fun evening of badminton!

prev.title: Week 4 of Our Summer Club Night
prev.summary: Join us at Claremont Stadium from 8pm to 11pm for rally marathons. For just €8, be part of the excitement. Whether you're experienced or new to the game, come and have fun. Grab your racket and sports gear, and join us this Wednesday night!

next.title: Join Us Tonight for Badminton Fun at Claremont Stadium!
next.summary: Join us tonight at Claremont Stadium from 8pm to 11pm for a fun evening of badminton! For just €8, you can hit shuttles like a pro, move around the court with ease, and have a great time. See you on the court tonight!
